title: VDRActionSpace
description: Discrete controller action space for Verified Dietary Reasoning. Volume tools are OFF by default and not part of the core action set.

core_actions.name: RETRIEVE
core_actions.description: Re-query FNDDS retrieval with refined text / multi-query expansion; update code_i and cands_i.

core_actions.name: RE_PORTION
core_actions.description: Run portion grid search (or re-estimate grams) for current code; update portion_g_i.

core_actions.name: RE_DECOMPOSE
core_actions.description: Ask perception to re-segment / re-hypothesize components; reset hyp_i for affected regions.

core_actions.name: ABSTAIN
core_actions.description: Refuse to emit a grounded nutrition answer; set s=abstain and abstain_reason.

core_actions.name: STOP
core_actions.description: Terminate episode; emit final (n, G, s) with s in {pass, corrected}.

optional_actions.name: CORRECT_CODE
optional_actions.description: Directly set code_i to a chosen Top-k candidate without a full re-retrieve (finer than RETRIEVE).

optional_actions.name: VOLUME_ESTIMATE
optional_actions.description: Monocular volume tool (SAM/depth). DEFAULT OFF per Tanabe failure mode; ablation only.

notes: Do not load legacy nutrition-regression expert weights.
VOLUME_ESTIMATE must stay disabled unless an ablation flag is explicitly set.
Rule verify is a tool/prior feature source, not a controller action.
